lemmas.name: fold_minkey
lemmas.statement: ∀ {α β : Type} [LinearOrder β] (f : α → β) (L : List α) (b : α), (L.foldl (fun best y => if f y < f best then y else best) b = b ∨ L.foldl (fun best y => if f y < f best then y else best) b ∈ L) ∧ f (L.foldl (fun best y => if f y < f best then y else best) b) ≤ f b ∧ ∀ y ∈ L, f (L.foldl (fun best y => if f y < f best then y else best) b) ≤ f y
lemmas.proof:
by
  intro α β _ f L
  induction L with
  | nil => intro b; simp
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro b
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    by_cases hlt : f a < f b
    · rw [if_pos hlt]
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := ih a
      refine ⟨?_, le_trans h2 (le_of_lt hlt), ?_⟩
      · rcases h1 with h | h
        · right; rw [h]; exact List.mem_cons_self
        · right; exact List.mem_cons_of_mem a h
      · intro x hx
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with rfl | hx'
        · exact h2
        · exact h3 x hx'
    · rw [if_neg hlt]
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := ih b
      refine ⟨?_, h2, ?_⟩
      · rcases h1 with h | h
        · left; exact h
        · right; exact List.mem_cons_of_mem a h
      · intro x hx
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with rfl | hx'
        · exact le_trans h2 (not_lt.mp hlt)
        · exact h3 x hx'

lemmas.name: min71
lemmas.statement: ∀ (targets : List String), (let res := (match targets with | [] => "" | b :: t => (b :: t).foldl (fun best y => if toLex (y.length, y) < toLex (best.length, best) then y else best) b); (res = "" ∧ targets = []) ∨ (res ∈ targets ∧ ∀ r ∈ targets, r.length > res.length ∨ (r.length = res.length ∧ res ≤ r)))
lemmas.proof:
by
  intro targets
  cases targets with
  | nil => dsimp only; left; exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  | cons b t =>
    dsimp only
    right
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := fold_minkey (fun s : String => toLex (s.length, s)) (b :: t) b
    generalize (b :: t).foldl (fun best y => if toLex (y.length, y) < toLex (best.length, best) then y else best) b = r at h1 h2 h3
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rcases h1 with h | h
      · rw [h]; exact List.mem_cons_self
      · exact h
    · intro y hy
      have := h3 y hy
      rw [Prod.Lex.le_iff] at this
      simp only [ofLex_toLex] at this
      rcases this with h | ⟨h, h'⟩
      · left; exact h
      · right; exact ⟨h.symm, h'⟩

lemmas.name: short71
lemmas.statement: ∀ (s : String) (k : Nat) (h : shortestBeautifulSubstring_precond s k), shortestBeautifulSubstring_postcond s k (let chars := s.data; let substrings := (List.range chars.length).flatMap (fun i => (List.range (chars.length - i + 1)).map (fun len => chars.drop i |>.take len)); let isBeautiful := fun sub => countOnes sub = k; let beautiful := substrings.filter (fun sub => isBeautiful sub); let targets := beautiful.map (·.asString) |>.filter (fun s => s ≠ ""); match targets with | [] => "" | b :: t => (b :: t).foldl (fun best y => if toLex (y.length, y) < toLex (best.length, best) then y else best) b) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro s k h
  unfold shortestBeautifulSubstring_postcond
  intro chars substrings isBeautiful beautiful targets
  exact min71 targets
